note: Targets currently built by LuisaCompute/examples/ (union of examples/xmake.lua + examples/CMakeLists.txt and the per-directory build files). 'sources' are relative to the group dir, which becomes src/<dir>/. Tokens: $LC = LuisaCompute root, $SRC = this repo's src/ root (the old examples/ root), $GROUP = src/<dir>. 'deps' list only EXTRA xmake targets beyond the per-target defaults (lc-runtime, lc-dsl, lc-vstl, stb-image, plus lc-gui when gui_dep/gui); lc-ast/lc-xir do not exist as xmake targets, so XIR-gated targets only carry the 'xir' condition key. 'requires' is AND-only: OR-conditions are spelled out in 'notes' (example_dstorage). ios_only targets intentionally have no 'sources' (their TUs are shared with the desktop examples and generated at configure time). 'mirror_as_test'==true means the CMake file passed MIRROR_AS_TEST, which also creates a test_<name> executable from the same sources.

targets.name: lc-example-ocr
targets.headless_hint: static library, no entry point (tests live in src/tests/unit/ocr)
targets.notes: wildcards come from xmake; cmake lists ~90 files explicitly. xmake: lc-yyjson when bundled, add_packages('yyjson') when lc_yyjson_use_xrepo is on (make the dependency conditional on the yyjson_xrepo condition key); cmake: links luisa-compute-ext-yyjson-interface (PUBLIC). cmake also links luisa-compute-ext-stb (and luisa-compute-ext-yyjson-interface when that target exists); xmake relies on the stb-image dep. PUBLIC include dirs: $GROUP and $SRC

targets.name: example_ocr
targets.headless_hint: `example_ocr --list-models` / `--help` need neither device nor package; real inference needs a validated .lcocr package and fails closed (see src/ocr/MODELS.md)

targets.name: lc-example-ocr-bench
targets.headless_hint: static library; only the benchmark fixtures (device-side bench kernels)
targets.notes: xmake: add_files('bench/*.cpp'), includes src/tests + src/tests/integration/ocr privately, and defines LUISA_OCR_BENCHMARK_SOURCE_REVISION from $LUISA_OCR_SOURCE_REVISION (default 'unknown', whitespace stripped) plus absolute LUISA_OCR_TEST_DATA_DIR / LUISA_OCR_EXAMPLES_DIR paths. cmake takes the revision from `git rev-parse HEAD` and the same absolute paths. The three defines must be regenerated from the new root; the JSON shows the token form and a safe default

targets.name: example_ocr_bench
targets.headless_hint: `example_ocr_bench <backend> <suite>` with suite = ops|decode|cnn|layout|gdn|moe|model|all; the synthetic suites need no weights

targets.name: lc-example-qwen
targets.headless_hint: static library, no entry point (host tests live in tests/unit/qwen)
targets.notes: Qwen3.5-4B text-only engine. Reuses the OCR tokenizer/detokenizer/status sources (compiled here, not linked from lc-example-ocr, to keep the dependency surface small); needs lc-tile for the Tile executor and lc-yyjson for the GGUF->tokenizer.json construction. QwenTokenizer is allocated/freed through Luisa's allocator with a custom deleter (luisa::delete_with_allocator), so it does not depend on EASTL's default_delete allocator configuration propagating through the static-lib dep chain. Includes: $GROUP for qwen/*.h, $SRC/ocr for ocr/*.h, yyjson headers.

targets.name: example_qwen
targets.headless_hint: `example_qwen --list-versions` / `--self-test` / `--help` need neither device nor model; real greedy inference needs data/Qwen3.5-4B-BF16.gguf and a backend (dsl verified cuda/dx/vk; tile verified dx, vk full inference currently device-lost)
